## Site Overview
Personal website of Lauri Hänninen, tech-savvy Product Marketing Lead at Trezor.
10+ years helping startups and tech companies grow through compelling product stories.
Self-custody & open-source advocate and Bitcoin enthusiast based in Prague, Czech Republic.
